items.html: And she begins to correct like in the time of the pregnancy, and ascends until beneath the Yesod. And there is the aspect of her first root, as is known, which is the Atara that remains there always; and also her aspect that descended into Beriah ascends from there. Then that aspect that ascended from Beriah grows a second time, to the measure of the entire Yesod. See elsewhere. And from there three ascend upon her, in Netzah and Hod, and not in Yesod; and she grows like them.
